**Route 14 Diversion: Market Street Closed**

**Dates:** Monday 16 November (start of service) to Friday 27 November (after last bus).

**What is changing?**
The **Market Street** stop is closed for road works. Buses will continue to serve **Central Square**, **School Road**, and **Mill Bridge**.

**Temporary Stop:**
Use **Riverside East** instead of Market Street. It is located 250 metres from the closed stop on a level path with a pedestrian crossing controlled by traffic lights.
